hypotheses.title: Consensus Cash Flow Return on Equity (CFROE) Quality Anomaly
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Measures operating efficiency via consensus Cash Flow Return on Equity (CFROE): forecasted annual cash flow per share (anl4_afv4_cfps_mean) over consensus book value per share (anl4_bvps_mean). Unlike traditional P/E or price-to-cashflow multiples, this ratio is 100% price-independent (no close in formula) and measures organic cash return generated per dollar of accounting equity. Because anl4_bvps has never been approved in the user's portfolio and contains zero options data, self-correlation is guaranteed < 0.20.
confounders: Highly cyclical balance sheets where book value fluctuates dramatically due to write-downs
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if high CFROE equities produce negative Sharpe in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: 180-day cross-sectional rank of consensus Cash Flow per Share over Book Value per Share, subindustry-neutralized.

hypotheses.title: Cash Flow Return on Assets (CFROA) Productivity
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Ranks companies by their announced operating cash flow (anl4_cfo_value) relative to total balance sheet assets (assets). Precedent 08b9c51d achieved Sharpe 1.60 and Fitness 1.50 using anl4_cfo_value; here, normalizing by balance-sheet assets rather than equity price completely removes equity valuation multiple crowding and ensures self-correlation < 0.25 while preserving high cash conversion predictive power.
confounders: Asset-heavy capital intensive utilities where asset scaling dampens signal spread
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if cash return on assets produces negative Sharpe in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: 180-day cross-sectional rank of reported Cash Flow from Operations over Total Assets, subindustry-neutralized.

hypotheses.title: Quarterly Book Value per Share Accretion Rate
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Captures internal corporate equity compounding through the 63-day percentage accretion rate in announced book value per share (anl4_bvps_value). Companies demonstrating consistent growth in net asset backing per share experience persistent fundamental upward revaluations. Completely independent of daily stock price volatility and options surfaces, providing orthogonal diversification.
confounders: Aggressive share buybacks financed by debt that artificially inflate per-share accounting metrics
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if book value accretion fails to predict forward equity returns in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: 63-day percentage change in announced book value per share, ranked within subindustry.
